account_and_mode.verification: Authenticated Stripe dashboard; persisted price detail pages and active product catalog.

product.name: RedirX Pay as you go
product.description: Pay once for the old URLs in your website move. $0.02 per URL, rounded up to the next whole dollar, with a $10 minimum. Check, edit and download your redirects.

product.name: RedirX Studio
product.description: 5,000 old URLs each month, shared across your websites and client projects. Check, edit and download your redirects. Cancel anytime.

product.name: RedirX Agency
product.description: 15,000 old URLs each month, shared across your websites and client projects. Check, edit and download your redirects. Cancel anytime.

product.name: RedirX Additional URLs
product.description: Old URLs used beyond your monthly plan, only with your approval. $0.02 per extra URL. Your total extra usage for the month is rounded up once to the next whole dollar.

trial.enforcement: Application; not a recurring Stripe credit.

usage_contract.stripe_quantity_unit: Old URLs, transformed into $1 groups of 50 with round=up.
usage_contract.payg_quantity: max(500, newly admitted old URLs); application must enforce the $10 minimum and record actual inventory separately.
usage_contract.additional_urls_quantity: Total approved excess old URLs for the subscription period; one consolidated invoice item; omit at zero.
usage_contract.entitlements: Metadata does not enforce allowances or refinement windows. Application must validate paid entitlement and approved usage.
usage_contract.subscription_topup_example: 51 approved extra URLs over the entire month cost $2, not $1 per separate addition.
